title: Life and Death Choice
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji's fingers hovered above the chessboard, the loss of his Heavenly Fate causing his fingertips to tremble slightly—and the Heavenly Eye's elimination countdown had quietly entered its final three hours.

text.content: The voice transmission piercing through his Mental Sea was like an ice awl, and Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes. Mo Xiansheng's aged voice still echoed: 'The Heavenly Eye has locked onto the Forbidden Grounds' coordinates! Retreat immediately!' The spiritual energy around him slightly stagnated, and the ancient talisman diagram he had just obtained still radiated a faint fluorescent glow, yet he had no time to attend to it. Beside him, Zhang Shen lay collapsed on the ground, covered in blood, his eyes filled with fear. In the distance, the bells of Tianqing Sect rang softly—the Elder's birthday banquet was about to begin.

dialogue.content: 'Mo Xiansheng, there is still one matter I have not yet settled.' Chen Ji said quietly in his heart, yet his gaze fell upon Zhang Shen's twisted face. He drew out a jade-green Jade Slip from his怀中, precisely the communication item Zhang Shen used to contact the outside world—the spiritual patterns remaining on it pointed toward the direction of the sect's Forbidden Grounds. Mo Xiansheng's silence was more unsettling than any words; after a long while, only a sigh came through: 'The因果 is coming, grasp it yourself.'

text.content: Chen Ji held the Jade Slip between his fingers, gently turning it. In the flickering candlelight, Zhang Shen's pupils suddenly contracted—he saw that Jade Slip, the communication item personally granted by the Elder's Senior Elder; aside from the core members of the Elder Council, no one in the sect knew of its existence. Zhang Shen's Adam's apple rolled, his lips trembling as if wanting to speak something, yet he forcibly swallowed it back. Chen Ji noticed his right index finger trembling slightly—that was calculating time—with less than an hour until the Elder's Senior Elder's birthday banquet began.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Ji.' A cold voice came from the doorway. Su Qingyao stood at the threshold in a pure white long dress, her sword not yet drawn, yet chill had already filled the entire meditation chamber. Her gaze like a blade swept across the collapsed Zhang Shen on the ground, then fell upon the jade-green Jade Slip in Chen Ji's hand, her pupils slightly narrowing: 'The Elder's Senior Elder's的信物... Where did you get this?' Her tone was calm, yet the knuckles gripping the sword had already turned faintly white—this meant she was far more shocked than she appeared.

'Senior Sister Su came at the perfect time.' Chen Ji raised his head, a warm smile almost harmless appearing on his face, casually tossing the Jade Slip toward Su Qingyao, 'Trouble the Senior Sister to examine this and see if it's genuine.' Su Qingyao took the Jade Slip, her spiritual sense probing into it; after a moment, her expression changed drastically: 'This is the Elder's Senior Elder's personal order... Where did you—' She abruptly looked up, her gaze toward Zhang Shen now carrying a hint of terror. Chen Ji gently patted Zhang Shen's shoulder, his voice warm as if coaxing a child: 'Brother Zhang, will you speak yourself, or shall I speak for you?'

At this moment, an ancient silhouette slowly emerged from the Tianji Record on Chen Ji's chest. Mo Xiansheng's form appeared ethereal in the dim light. The instant Zhang Shen saw that phantom, his entire body was struck like by thunder, scrambling backward: 'You—you all... What exactly are you people!' Mo Xiansheng's voice carried the vicissitudes of age: 'Zhang Shen, the master you serve behind... in those days, he was merely a speck of dust beneath my feet. Let me ask you one question—did the Elder's Senior Elder tell you what truly lies hidden in the Forbidden Grounds?'

Zhang Shen's complexion appeared deathly pale under the candlelight. He remained silent for a very long time, his Adam's apple rolling up and down, finally seeming to have made some decisive resolve, his voice hoarse: 'The Elder's Senior Elder said... deep within the Forbidden Grounds lies an ancient cave dwelling, containing something so heaven-defying it could allow a mortal to directly step into the Void Refining stage. He needs to refine the cave dwelling'srestriction, but is missing a key—' He abruptly looked up, a flash of madness in his eyes, 'He said that key is the Tianji Record!' Chen Ji's gaze slightly condensed, his smile finally fading, replaced by an abyssal coldness.

text.content: The air seemed to solidify for an instant. Su Qingyao's sword had already been unsheathed three inches, the cold light reflecting on Zhang Shen's face, making him shiver all over. Yet Chen Ji suddenly laughed—that smile was warm yet hair-raisingly sinister: 'So that's how it is. The Elder's Senior Elder wants the Tianji Record, yet doesn't know it lies in the hands of atrash Servant Disciple—Brother Zhang, do you think this is irony or providence?' His fingers gently tapped the table, one, two, the rhythm steady as if calculating something. Mo Xiansheng's phantom silently observed all this, a trace of undetectable approval flickering in his eyes.

Chen Ji slowly rose, pacing to the window. Tianqing Sect's night was deep as ink, the Elder's Hall in the distance blazed with lights, the sound of silk and bamboo faintly audible. He closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record within his Mental Sea. The characters on the fragmented page glowed faintly, a blurry image gradually emerging—the birthday banquet, with the Elder's Senior Elder seated at the main seat, publicly announcing some major matter; three months later, the Forbidden Grounds cave dwelling's gate wide open, the Elder's Senior Elder leading the crowd in; and at the deepest part of that cave dwelling, a pitch-black coffin lay quietly, the aura emanating from within causing Chen Ji's hairs to stand on end. Heavenly Fate instantly dropped 5 points, he groaned, a trace of blood appearing at the corner of his mouth.

'Chen Ji!' Su Qingyao's exclamation rang out, she immediately supported Chen Ji's swaying body, her gaze filled with worry. Chen Ji waved his hand, indicating he was fine. His pupils reflected the image of the Tianji Record, his voice low: 'I saw two paths. The first, the Elder's Senior Elder makes his move at the birthday banquet, publicly exposing that I possess the Tianji Record, using sect rules to put me to death; the second, he remains still, acts three months later at the Forbidden Grounds, directly seizing the treasure and eliminating witnesses.' He paused, the corner of his mouth lifting in a cold smile, 'Both paths, for him, are certain victories. Unfortunately—he doesn't know that I have already seen his chessboard.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's expression turned extremely ugly. She was the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow; she knew better than anyone the Elder's Senior Elder's position in Tianqing Sect—that was the stabilizing pillar of the entire sect, even the Sect Master had to treat him with courtesy. 'What do you intend to do?' Her voice was pressed extremely low, 'The Elder's Senior Elder is at the Void Refining later stage cultivation; right now, neither you nor I are a match for even one of his moves. Even knowing his scheme, what can we possibly do?' Chen Ji did not answer, but instead turned to look at the collapsed Zhang Shen on the ground, his gaze deep as an abyss.

'Brother Zhang, let me ask you one more thing.' Chen Ji squatted down, meeting Zhang Shen's eyes at the same level, 'What benefit did the Elder's Senior Elder promise you? Making you betray the sect, sell out your fellow disciples, even going so far as to invite the Demonic Path through the gates?' Zhang Shen's body shook violently, his lips trembling, his eye sockets actually reddening: 'He said... he said after the matter is done, he'd make me the Vice Sect Master of Tianqing Sect... I know I was stupid, but... I had no choice, my family members are in his hands...' At these words, this once arrogant Inner Disciple actually started crying like a child.

text.content: Chen Ji quietly watched Zhang Shen weep, his face showing no emotional fluctuation. After a moment, he stood up, his voice flat as if discussing today's weather: 'Finished crying?' Zhang Shen abruptly looked up, a flash of hope flickering in his eyes—he thought Chen Ji would soften. Yet Chen Ji's next words shattered his hope completely: 'I will send people to rescue your family. But you made a mistake, and you must bear the consequences.' He turned to Su Qingyao, 'Senior Sister, what do you think should be done with this person?' Su Qingyao's brow creased tightly; she knew this was a test—Chen Ji was observing how she would choose, also observing which side she would stand on.

choice.prompt: Life and Death Choice—the fate of insider Zhang Shen, determined by you. At this moment, the Elder's Senior Elder is still unaware of what has transpired here; your choice will affect the entire pattern of Tianqing Sect, even impacting the Forbidden Grounds situation three months later.

choices.description: Take Zhang Shen as a hidden chess piece, letting him continue as a double agent beside the Elder's Senior Elder. Use his guilt and his family's safety as control leverage, while preserving a direct intelligence line to the Elder's Senior Elder. But Zhang Shen's disposition is unstable; if he turns against you later, the consequences are unpredictable.
choices.visible_cost: Need to disperse energy to monitor Zhang Shen, and he knows some of Chen Ji's trump cards
choices.visible_reward: Gain a top-tier intelligence line to the Elder's Senior Elder, can reverse the layout at critical moments
choices.risk_hint: Zhang Shen betrayed once before, hard to guarantee he won't do it a second time
choices.process_label: chen ji taps table three times, makes decision

text.content: Chen Ji leaned down, stuffing a pitch-black Elixir into Zhang Shen's mouth. That elixir dissolved the instant it touched his tongue, a cold aura flowing through his meridians. Zhang Shen's expression greatly changed: 'What—what is this!' Chen Ji patted his face, his voice warm: 'Heart-Devouring Pill. Requires the antidote every three months, otherwise the dantian will rot from the inside. Brother Zhang, from now on we are on the same boat; you should understand what needs to be done.' Zhang Shen trembled all over, yet dared not show the slightest resistance.

choices.description: Kill Zhang Shen on the spot, eliminating the threat forever. This man knows too many secrets; keeping him is a disaster. But the Elder's Senior Elder will certainly notice something amiss, possibly striking first, greatly increasing the variables at the birthday banquet.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the intelligence line to the Elder's Senior Elder, and may alert the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the risk of information leakage, and candisguised as Zhang Shen taking his own life out of guilt, buying more layout time for the birthday banquet
choices.risk_hint: After losing contact with Zhang Shen, the Elder's Senior Elder will certainly be on guard, possibly attacking first
choices.process_label: chen ji stops tapping, cold light flashes in eyes

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak again. He merely gently raised his hand, a wisp of pure spiritual energy piercing into Zhang Shen's Brow Center. Zhang Shen's eyes instantly widened, his lips opening and closing as if wanting to speak, yet could no longer utter any sound. His body softly fell, the final light in his eyes gradually fading. Su Qingyao's breath halted, her hand already gripping the sword hilt—but ultimately, she did not intervene. Chen Ji turned to look at her, his smile still warm: 'Does Senior Sister think I did wrong?'

choices.text: Lay a Long Line to Catch a Big Fish
choices.description: Intentionally let Zhang Shen leave, having him bring the false news 'Chen Ji is dead' to the Elder's Senior Elder. While the Elder's Senior Elder relaxes his guard, secretly collect evidence of his crimes; when the time is ripe, strike to kill. But this requires extremely precise planning, and during this period must hide one's own whereabouts.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji must conceal his identity and name, unable to cultivate normally during this period
choices.visible_reward: Gain a perfect潜伏 period, can leisurely arrange things, and the Elder's Senior Elder's attention will shift elsewhere

text.content: Chen Ji drew an易容符 from his怀, and with spiritual energy activation, his features slowly changed within a burst of淡金色 light, instantly transforming into an unremarkable middle-aged man. He patted Zhang Shen's shoulder, his voice carrying a hint of seduction: 'Brother Zhang, help me take a message to the Elder's Senior Elder—just say Chen Ji is dead, killed by the residual effects of the Forbidden Grounds. As for the Tianji Record's whereabouts, you still don't know.' Zhang Shen's eyes widened, his face full of disbelief. Chen Ji淡淡 smiled: 'Go, don't keep me waiting long.'

Mo Xiansheng's phantom quietly observed Chen Ji's every decision. When the aftershocks of the final choice subsided, his voice sounded again, carrying an unfathomable depth: 'Chen Ji, do you know the origin of that ancient cave dwelling the Elder's Senior Elder spoke of?' Chen Ji's heart stirred, quickly asking further. Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a very long time before slowly saying: 'The owner of that cave dwelling has inextricable connections with the original owner of the Tianji Record. If you guessed correctly, what lies hidden there is precisely the next missing page of the Tianji Record—or possibly even the complete core of the Tianji Record.'

Chen Ji's pupils suddenly contracted. The core of the Tianji Record—what this meant, he understood better than anyone. The fragmented pages he currently possessed could foresee three hours into the future; if he could obtain the core, could he completely free himself from the Heavenly Eye's control? However, Mo Xiansheng's next words jolted him awake from the ecstasy: 'But remember, the things within that cave dwelling are not opportunities, but trials. The core of the Tianji Record shares the same source and root as the Heavenly Eye—when the original owner sealed it into the Forbidden Grounds, it was precisely to prevent it from falling into the Heavenly Eye's hands. If you recklessly enter...' He did not finish, but the unspoken meaning behind his words made Chen Ji's spine grow cold.

At this moment, a sudden earth-shaking spiritual energy fluctuation came from the distance. Su Qingyao's expression greatly changed: 'This is—the direction of the Elder's Hall! The birthday banquet has already begun!' Chen Ji strode quickly to the window, only to see above Tianqing Sect Main Peak, brilliant fireworks shot into the sky, celestial cranes circling, auspicious clouds lingering. Yet beneath that facade of peace, Chen Ji acutely caught a barely detectable aura of killing intent. His Tianji Record suddenly grew hot, a line of golden characters appearing in his Mental Sea—'The Elder's Senior Elder has arrived; your choice determines who lives and who dies today.'

dialogue.content: 'Time is running out.' Chen Ji said quietly. He turned to Su Qingyao, his gaze carrying an unprecedented seriousness: 'Senior Sister, I need you to help me with one thing.' Su Qingyao's brow creased tightly, yet did not refuse: 'Speak.' Chen Ji spoke word by word: 'Later at the birthday banquet, the Elder's Senior Elder will certainly make his move. I need you at that moment, to publicly question Zhang Shen's death—no, don't question, just cry.' Su Qingyao froze: 'What?' The corner of Chen Ji's mouth lifted in a deeply meaningful smile: 'Cry as heartbreakingly as possible. Say your dear friend Zhang Shen was framed by a villain, and you demand justice for him. As for who that villain is—' He lightly brushed the dust from his sleeves, 'Let the Elder's Senior Elder guess for himself.'

text.content: Su Qingyao stared at Chen Ji for a very long time, her emotions complex and difficult to discern. Finally, she lightly sighed: 'Your brain... if used on the proper path, the entire Tianqing Sect wouldn't be able to hold you.' Chen Ji smiled, offering no rebuttal. He turned to gaze at the night sky outside the window, Tianqing Sect's lights flickering like the Milky Way in the darkness, the sound of flute and song from the birthday banquet faintly audible. His gaze was deep and calm, as if everything was under his control. Yet the instant he was about to step through the threshold, Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again in his Mental Sea, this time carrying unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, the Heavenly Eye's elimination countdown—only three hours remain.' Chen Ji's footsteps slightly faltered, then continued forward, his silhouette disappearing into the night.
